requirements: Free website submission into Webwiki's site search engine
Website data form asks for URL plus optional title and description - if title/description are omitted the site's own meta data is used
A confirmation checkbox must be ticked before clicking 'Add Your Website'
preparation: Preferred title and description (otherwise Webwiki pulls your site's meta tags)
Keywords, images, and social links for enriching the listing afterwards via 'Update Profile'
workflow: Enter URL, title, and description; tick the confirmation checkbox; click 'Add Your Website'
On the confirmation screen, click the provided link to view the new listing
Click 'Update Profile' on the listing to add keywords, images, and social media links
watchFor: The add-website page returned HTTP 403 to automated fetches - the flow is browser-oriented

The French locale (webwiki.fr) displayed 'La soumission du site Web est temporairement désactivée' - submissions may be temporarily deactivated on some locales; verify the form actually accepts input on webwiki.com before preparing assets
Webwiki describes itself as a search engine, not a launch board - a listing may surface automatically even without submission
countsAsLive: A dedicated Webwiki page for the domain exists and is reachable via the link on the post-submit confirmation screen, showing title/description
unknowns: Whether submission is currently enabled on the English site (the FR locale showed a temporary deactivation notice)
Whether listing links are dofollow on current pages
Review or moderation process, if any, after submission
